name: eizhu
description: eizhu 桌面版构建编排（Tauri 2，见 docs/TAURI_MIGRATION.md）

scripts.app:icon: node scripts/round-app-icon.mjs src-tauri/app-icon.png 0.22 src-tauri/app-icon-foreground.png && tauri icon src-tauri/app-icon-manifest.json
scripts.android:icon: npm run app:icon && node scripts/verify-mobile-icons.mjs android
scripts.android:dev: npm run android:icon && tauri android dev
scripts.android:build: npm run android:icon && tauri android build
scripts.ios:icon: npm run app:icon && node scripts/verify-mobile-icons.mjs ios
scripts.ios:dev: npm run ios:icon && tauri ios dev
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:icon && tauri ios build
